title: Simultaneous completed coefficient tensor and adjunction transport data
statement: Fix a family of schemes and the site and tensor presentations [def-pur-completed-coefficient-tensor-transport-models] and per-arrow normalized adjunction presentations [def-pur-completed-coefficient-adjunction-transport-models]. Define the natural transformations from ordinary pullback to completed pullback on the complete subcategories by the actual completion units. A completed tensor/pullback transport presentation consists of the representative-normalized ordinary pullback tensorators, strong completed pullback tensorators on each coefficient side, monoidality of those actual completion-unit transformations, and monoidality of b relative to the restriction tensorators. A simultaneous family transport datum comprises these data at every scheme and morphism, the tensor completion-unit normalization, pullback and scalar-mate representative normalizations, and the actual completed adjunction identities. Include whole-system models [def-pur-completed-operation-model-data] and their comparison, substitution and structural predicates [def-pur-completed-operation-comparison-data]. Include completeness of total limits of normalized systems and an identification of the completed R coefficient unit with total limit of the system unit. Include R and constant completed pullback-composition isomorphisms; the R isomorphism satisfies its total-limit square with the canonical system composition, and the two isomorphisms commute under b. All these are fields of a data presentation; this definition asserts no existence.
